_about: Acetonitrile (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.32 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetonitrile, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
